business.title: What kind of business is this?
business.description: e.g. 'a three-person electrical contractor', 'a design studio'.

currency.title: Which currency is the cash in?
currency.description: A three-letter code, e.g. USD, EUR or GBP.

tools.name: cash_forecast
tools.description: The 13-week cash forecast: the first week cash drops below the cushion (the warning week) and what goes out then, the tightest week, cash in the bank, late items, every week-end balance, and each what-if compared with the plan. Call it first for any question about cash.

tools.name: set_balance
tools.description: Save the cash in the bank (amount in ordinary units, as of a date, default today) and, if given, the cushion to keep on hand. Call it as soon as the person says what is in the bank.

tools.name: add_cash_item
tools.description: Save money the business expects: an invoice coming in or a bill going out, once or repeating (weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly). An existing name is updated, never duplicated, so use it to move a date or change an amount for real. Call it as soon as one is mentioned, before you describe it. For a 'what if', use what_if instead.

tools.name: settle_cash_item
tools.description: Record that expected money came in or a bill was paid: a one-off leaves the forecast, a repeating one moves to its next date, and the bank balance moves by the amount. Call it the moment the person says it arrived or went out.

tools.name: remove_cash_item
tools.description: Take an expected item out of the plan for good, such as a cancelled job or a bill that ended.

tools.name: what_if
tools.description: Try a what-if without changing the plan, under a short scenario name: delay an expected item by some weeks (a month late is 4), drop one, or add a new cost or income such as a hire; 'clear' removes the scenario. The reply compares its warning week with the plan. Call it whenever the person asks 'what if'.

tools.name: list_cash_items
tools.description: Every expected item and what-if change, with ids, amounts, dates and repeats.

tools.name: page_set_balance
tools.description: Save the cash in the bank and the cushion.

tools.name: page_add_cash_item
tools.description: Save an expected invoice or bill.

tools.name: page_settle_cash_item
tools.description: Record that expected money came in or a bill was paid.

tools.name: page_what_if
tools.description: Try a what-if without changing the plan.
